mentions.name: Adaptive LLM email spam filter
mentions.description: A small open-source adaptive filter designed to detect and deal with LLM-generated email spam. The project is kept readable for packagers and includes verbose comments so people can quickly audit the source.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Drafting a small adaptive filter to deal with LLM generated email spam etc.

I don't often have time to do OSS projects, but will keep it readable for packagers.  The most time consuming part will be overly verbose commenting needed for people to be able to audit the source quickly.
